forecaster_note: Fri: short-period ENE/NE swell mix continues, maybe a bit of longer south swell filling in for more push at S-facing breaks; winds a touch better at dawn then NE onshore again. Sat: chest to head high, light N/NW dawn is the cleanest window, then NE; Sun: similar size, N winds all day — S-facing spots cleanest. — Surfline forecaster (Anthony Spinks), Fri 23 Oct

days.surfline_text: Short period ENE / NE swell mix continues, but we may also see a bit of longer south swell fill in. Not a lot but perhaps enough to see a bit more push at south facing breaks.  Winds perhaps a bit better in the morning today though - going offshore. Then NE'lies again and needing a bit of shelter - south facing breaks.
